Experience unparalleled cavity protection with SuperMouth’s groundbreaking prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste. Specifically formulated for adults and children at high risk for cavities, this advanced toothpaste combines 1.1% sodium fluoride (5000 ppm) with our unique Hydroxamin complex—a blend of nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2. Designed to be the ultimate defense against tooth decay, it provides superior care and protection for your teeth, gums, and microbiome.

Key Features:

  • Prescription Strength Protection: Contains 1.1% sodium fluoride (5000 ppm) for advanced cavity prevention.
  • Expert Formulation: Crafted by leading dentists and oral care specialists for optimal dental health.
  • Hydroxamin Complex: Contains nano-hydroxyapatite, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2 to assist enamel health naturally.
  • High Concentration Ingredients: Includes nano-hydroxyapatite and xylitol at least 10% for maximum effectiveness.
  • Microbiome-Friendly: Free from essential oils like peppermint, tea tree, or eucalyptus, preserving oral microbiome balance.
  • Low Abrasivity: Relative Dentin Abrasivity (RDA) of 67 ensures safe use without enamel wear.
  • Comprehensive Oral Care: Each ingredient meticulously selected to promote overall mouth health.
  • Safety Guarantee: Every ingredient ranks #1 (excluding fluoride which is a 2) on EWG (Environmental Working Group), ensuring safety and purity.
  • pH-Balanced Formula: Maintains mouth’s natural equilibrium for lasting freshness.
  • Clean Ingredients: No artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, or antibiotics; non-GMO.
  • Prebiotic Support: Includes inulin and other prebiotics to nurture a healthy oral microbiome.

Global Excellence: Made in the USA with premium, globally sourced ingredients.

Inclusive and Responsible: Gluten-free and paraben-free for broad user appeal and environmental responsibility.

FAQs
items.html:
What makes SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste different from regular fluoride toothpaste?
SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste contains 1.1% sodium fluoride (5000 ppm), which is significantly higher than the fluoride content in regular toothpaste. This higher concentration provides advanced cavity prevention and protection for both adults and children at high risk for cavities.
How is SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste different from other brands with similar products?
Our prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste stands out because it contains no artificial ingredients such as flavors, colors, sweeteners, or preservatives. It is packed with prebiotics like inulin and maintains an alkaline pH to support a healthy oral environment. Additionally, it features our proprietary Hydroxamin complex, which blends at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite with vitamins D3 and K2 for enhanced enamel support and overall oral health.
Who should use prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste?
Prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste is ideal for individuals who are at high risk for cavities, such as those with a history of dental caries or those with reduced salivary flow. It is suitable for both adults and children who need extra protection to maintain optimal oral health.
Can I use prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste every day?
Yes, SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste is designed for daily use. However, it should be used as directed by your dentist or physician. Follow their recommendations regarding the frequency and amount to ensure optimal results and safety.
What flavors are available for SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste?
Our prescription-strength fluoride toothpaste is available in four delicious flavors: chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and mint. These flavors make daily brushing a pleasant experience while providing advanced protection for your teeth and gums.
How do I purchase SuperMouth’s Prescription-Strength Fluoride Toothpaste?
This toothpaste is available exclusively through dental offices and must be prescribed by a dentist or physician. If your dentist does not currently prescribe this product, you can provide us with their contact information, and we will reach out to them on your behalf to make this toothpaste accessible to you. If you don’t currently have a dentist, you can contact our customer service team, and we will refer you to one of our SuperMouth Pro dental professionals in your area.
